fateHarm.title: Vitals
fateHarm.hitDescription: Enter the incoming shifts before armor, then choose how to absorb the hit.
fateHarm.onlyFree: Marked cells and occupied slots cannot be used.
fateHarm.invalid: Enter a positive whole number of shifts and a valid armor rating if you are applying armor.
fateHarm.noHit: Armor absorbs the hit. Do not mark harm; check with the table whether the attacker gets a boost.
fateHarm.takenOut: Only {max} shifts can be absorbed; {shortfall} would remain. Resolve being taken out with the table. Nothing is marked here.
fateHarm.extremeWarning: This permanently replaces the selected aspect. A high concept cannot be replaced.
fateHarm.attackerClaim: The attacker gets one free invoke on each new injury.
fateHarm.stale: The card changed. Select a current option and review it again.
fateHarm.legacyBlocked: Assign the old injury to an eligible extra slot before using extra slots.
fateHarm.inactiveExtreme: Extreme consequences are inactive with conditions.
fateHarm.usedExtreme: Available again after a major milestone.
fateHarm.treatmentDescription: After a successful overcome, confirm treatment. The current partial scene or session does not count toward recovery.
fateHarm.clearDescription: The recovery interval has passed. Clear this injury from the card?
